Who was Feroze Gandhi beyond being Indira Gandhi's husband and the father of Rajiv and Sanjay Gandhi? Explore his life and legacy with Shubhankar Mishra.
The Nehru-Gandhi family is central to India's political history. But how much do we know about Feroze Gandhi's own story?
This video explores his life, his relationship with Indira Gandhi and his role in Indian politics. A freedom fighter, journalist and Member of Parliament, Feroze Gandhi had an identity that extended beyond his family connections.
How should we remember him today? Watch the story and share your view in the comments.
